definitions.explanation: A book, magazine, or other printed work that has been recently published. Often seen in bookstores to highlight the latest releases.

examples.japanese: {新刊|しんかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新刊|しんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought my favorite author's new book.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書店|しょてん}→書店：04205_shoten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新刊|しんかん}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{面白|おもしろ}そうな⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found an interesting-looking novel in the new releases section of the bookstore.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly seen on bookstore shelves and in advertisements. Can refer to any type of newly published material including novels, manga, magazines, and academic works.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新刊|しんかん}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧ (new releases section)
- {新刊|しんかん}⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧ (new publication guide)
- {新刊|しんかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (a new book comes out)
- {新刊|しんかん}{書|しょ} (newly published book)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{既刊|きかん}→既刊：17885_kikan⟧: previously published — books already on the market
- ⟦{近刊|きんかん}→近刊：29343_kinkan⟧: forthcoming publication — a book that will be published soon
